weapons.name: Shortsword
weapons.effect: Strike: if the die shows a 6, deal $+1$ hit.

weapons.name: Spear
weapons.effect: Strike may target a foe in an adjacent zone.

weapons.name: Hand Axe
weapons.effect: Strike: if the foe falls, you may Move once for free.

weapons.name: Dagger
weapons.effect: Once per round, if you Moved this phase, you may Strike as \easy (still deals 1 hit).

weapons.name: Flail
weapons.effect: Strike: ignore Armor on that hit.

weapons.name: Longsword
weapons.effect: Strike deals 2 hits (still \medium{} \energy{1}). Occupies weapon and off-hand.

weapons.name: Greataxe
weapons.effect: You gain the action \textbf{Cleaving Blow} (\hard{} \hard{}): deal 3 hits to one foe in your zone. Occupies weapon and off-hand.

weapons.name: Warhammer
weapons.effect: Strike: deal $+1$ hit and Bind that foe. Occupies weapon and off-hand.

weapons.name: Bow
weapons.effect: Strike may target a foe up to two zones away, but not in your own zone. Occupies weapon and off-hand.

weapons.name: Crossbow
weapons.effect: Strike deals 2 hits to a foe in an adjacent zone; you cannot Move the same round. Occupies weapon and off-hand.

weapons.name: Shard-Staff
weapons.effect: Once per round, raise one die face on a spell you cast by $+1$ (max 6). Occupies weapon and off-hand.

offhand.name: Shield
offhand.effect: When you Guard, ignore the first \textbf{two} hits, or grant Guard to one ally in your zone instead of yourself.

offhand.name: Buckler
offhand.effect: Once per fight, after you take a hit, ignore it (before Armor).

offhand.name: Parrying Knife
offhand.effect: Once per round, when a foe in your zone hits you, deal 1 hit back.

armor.name: Light
armor.notes: 1 Armor box. Soft leather, padded cloak, crystal-scale vest.

armor.name: Medium
armor.notes: 2 Armor boxes. Mail, brigandine, scavenged plate.

armor.name: Heavy
armor.notes: 3 Armor boxes. Full plate or Shard-forged harness. You may \kw{Move} only once per round; Static Field / Static Rain deals 1 hit at round start unless Guarded.

gear.name: Rations
gear.effect: At Camp, spend to regain $+1$ Supply (once per Camp).

gear.name: Bandages
gear.effect: After a fight, heal 1 Hit on one character (once).

gear.name: Lockpicks
gear.effect: Once per Gate, treat one Hard Hard lock/forge check as Medium.

gear.name: Climbing Kit
gear.effect: Once per expedition, ignore one Climb/ford failure on a STR check (still mark the clock/Supply).

gear.name: Lantern
gear.effect: Ignore darkness penalties; Swarm foes prefer the bearer.

gear.name: Forged Papers
gear.effect: Once, auto-succeed one Easy or Medium CHA/INT forgery or passage check; then gone.

gear.name: Antidote
gear.effect: Clear Burning, Bound, or Marked from one character (once).

gear.name: Smoke Pot
gear.effect: Combat: Easy Use Gear. Until your next round, foes in your zone cannot target adjacent zones.

gear.name: Firepot
gear.effect: Combat: Easy Use Gear. Deal 1 hit to every foe in an adjacent zone; they are Burning.

gear.name: Flash Glass
gear.effect: Combat: Easy Use Gear. One foe in your zone loses Guard and is Marked.

gear.name: Crowbar
gear.effect: $+1$ die on one STR force/pry check per Gate.

gear.name: Rope and Grapple
gear.effect: Once per Gate, treat a Vertical Drop Move as a single zone.

gear.name: Spare Kit
gear.effect: Once per expedition, restore 1 spent Armor box outside combat.

gear.name: Guild Token
gear.effect: Spend to clear 1 Guild Debt pressure, or as 1 Favor for a Guild Bargain.

gear.name: Cult Charm
gear.effect: Once per Gate, reroll one Omen result; keep the second.

gear.name: Field Journal
gear.effect: Once per Camp, Scout or Lore Counsel without counting as one of your two Counsel picks.

common.name: Ash Cloak
common.effect: Once per fight, ignore the first hit from a Rear foe.

common.name: Iron Nail Charm
common.effect: Your first Strike each fight deals $+1$ hit.

common.name: Bone Dice
common.effect: Once per Camp, reroll one Attribute Check die.

common.name: Guild Brass Ring
common.effect: Bargain with the Guild at $+1$ face once per Town.

common.name: Vein Whisper
common.effect: Once per Gate, learn if an adjacent hex holds a Gate (yes/no).

common.name: Cracked Lens
common.effect: Once per fight, raise one assigned die face by $+1$ (max 6).

common.name: Salt Band
common.effect: Ignore the first plague Hazard hit each expedition.

common.name: Lantern Shard
common.effect: Lantern effect without occupying a gear slot; Swarm still prefer you.

common.name: Soft Boots
common.effect: Once per Gate, treat one Easy DEX sneak as automatic success.

common.name: Scar Salve Tin
common.effect: Once per campaign, ignore one Scar you would take.

common.name: Crow Feather
common.effect: Once per fight, Move as a free Easy (no die).

common.name: Debt Stub
common.effect: Spend to clear 1 Debt with any faction (then destroy).

common.name: Glass Bead
common.effect: Reclaim 1 Energy when you first enter a Gate each expedition.

common.name: Pit Badge
common.effect: Hold the Line / Guard allies: Guard lasts until end of next round once per fight.

common.name: Tunnel Chalk
common.effect: Once per delve, mark a chamber as explored without rolling Feature next visit to that hex.

common.name: Rust Key
common.effect: Once per Gate, open one locked Vault Door as Medium instead of Hard Hard.

common.name: Ember Thumb Ring
common.effect: Your first hit each fight also sets the foe Burning.

common.name: Quiet Bell
common.effect: Once per fight, cancel one Swarm Move into your zone.

common.name: Marching Strap
common.effect: Once per expedition, ignore one Supply cost for a Camp.

common.name: Whetstone of Dust
common.effect: Once per fight, Strike ignores Guard.

uncommon.name: Mirror Shard
uncommon.effect: \defensive{} Once per fight, redirect the first hit you would take to a foe in your zone.

uncommon.name: Resonance Ear
uncommon.effect: Once per Gate, roll Omen twice and pick one.

uncommon.name: Blood Ledger Clip
uncommon.effect: When you drop a foe, reclaim 1 Energy (once per fight).

uncommon.name: Ashsteel Torc
uncommon.effect: Gain $+1$ Armor box while bound (stacks with worn armor for absorption order after Guard).

uncommon.name: Gatecutter's Pick
uncommon.effect: Once per delve, auto-succeed one Medium DEX lock/scout check.

uncommon.name: Cantor's Reed
uncommon.effect: Once per fight, one ally in your zone gains Guard.

uncommon.name: Void Thread
uncommon.effect: Once per fight, Bind one foe in your zone (no die; after a successful Strike).

uncommon.name: Crown Bailiff Seal
uncommon.effect: Clear 1 Crown Debt when you Camp on Crown Scar Road (once per expedition).

uncommon.name: Star-Cult Rosary
uncommon.effect: Spend Cult Favor once per Gate to ignore $+1$ Stress from a single source.

uncommon.name: Hound Tooth
uncommon.effect: Strike against the most wounded foe in reach deals $+1$ hit.

uncommon.name: Glass Lung Filter
uncommon.effect: Ignore Exhausted's $-1$ die once per expedition.

uncommon.name: Phalanx Brooch
uncommon.effect: \defensive{} Allies in your zone ignore the first hit each fight.

uncommon.name: Smuggler's Purse
uncommon.effect: Carry $+1$ Raw without the usual Stress for carrying it out of one Gate.

uncommon.name: Echo Needle
uncommon.effect: Once per fight, Mark a foe in any zone.

uncommon.name: Aetherwick
uncommon.effect: Once per Camp, burn to refill 2 Energy without a full Camp Energy refill counting this as Counsel.

rare.name: Captain's Gorget
rare.effect: \defensive{} Guard ignores three hits. Bind cost: mutation check.

rare.name: Veinheart Spike
rare.effect: Strike deals $+1$ hit always. Once per fight, ignore Armor.

rare.name: Night Broker Contract
rare.effect: Once per delve, force one Minion to skip its phase.

rare.name: Seer's Prism
rare.effect: Once per fight, discard and redraw up to two unassigned party dice.

rare.name: Iron Oath Plate
rare.effect: \defensive{} Restore 1 Armor box at the start of each fight.

rare.name: Hungering Knife
rare.effect: When you deal 3+ hits with one action, heal 1 Hit (once per fight).

rare.name: Static Null Rod
rare.effect: Ignore Static Field / Static Rain hits. Heavy armor Move limit still applies.

rare.name: Choir Mask
rare.effect: Once per fight, deal 1 hit to every foe in your zone (\medium{} \energy{1} action added while bound).

rare.name: Deep Gate Key
rare.effect: Once per campaign, enter one ring-B Gate without rolling Omen (still Camp first).

rare.name: Ash Phoenix Band
rare.effect: Once per campaign, when you would go Down, stand with 2 Hits and take no Scar.

prismatic.name: Heart-Splinter Crown
prismatic.effect: Pool $+1$ die while bound (max 5). Mark $+1$ Stress each Gate entry.

prismatic.name: World-Crack Lens
prismatic.effect: Once per fight, cast one Circle II spell you know without Energy (Stress still applies if printed).

prismatic.name: Nameless Blade
prismatic.effect: Strike deals 2 hits and ignores Guard and Armor. Each fight you use it, mark $+1$ Stress.

prismatic.name: Star-Grave Mantle
prismatic.effect: \defensive{} Ignore all hits from one Monster phase per fight. Then mark $+1$ Stress.

prismatic.name: Cabal's Last Pattern
prismatic.effect: Once per campaign, treat one Fell action as Dire for dice needed (still pay Fell Energy). Mark $+2$ Stress.
